title: finding(react): `useRecordSearch` keys its search effect on the caller-supplied `getDisplayName`, a published option — an inline resolver either never searches or double-fires, the dependency AGENTS.md §5 #10 bans
body:
Path: none | 违反 #8640 裁决第 10 例(调用方提供的身份)

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) out of objectui#7393's measurement dispatch. The dev found it while instrumenting that hook and correctly did not fold it in. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The declared contract, quoted from `AGENTS.md` §5 commandment **#10**

> **Never depend on the IDENTITY of a `useMemo` / `useCallback` result (objectui#8640 …)** … never let correctness rest on the object or function that comes back — ⛔ not as a `useEffect` / `useMemo` dependency, ⛔ not as a `Map` / `WeakMap` key, ⛔ not in a reference comparison.

## The site

`packages/react/src/hooks/useRecordSearch.ts`, read on objectui `origin/main` `0febe1a59` at 2026-09-19T20:27Z by the filing seat:

- `:107` — `getDisplayName?: (objectDef: any, record: any) => string;` — a **public, optional option** of the hook.
- `:398` — that same `getDisplayName` is the **last entry in the search effect's dependency array**.

`@object-ui/react` is **17.6.0** with `private: false`, and the package exposes only the `"."` entry, so this hook and its option are public API.

## The two failures a consumer gets, and why they are opposite

The effect's cleanup clears the pending debounce timer. So a caller that passes an **inline** resolver — the obvious spelling for an optional callback — re-creates it on every parent render and:

- **Parent re-renders faster than `debounceMs` (250 ms default)** ⇒ the effect re-runs and clears the pending timer every time ⇒ **the search never fires at all**.
- **Renders are sparse** ⇒ each one issues an extra **byte-identical** request after the first has already gone out.

⇒ One banned dependency, two opposite user-visible outcomes, neither of which names its cause at the call site.

## ⭐ Why nothing in this repository catches it

All three in-repo callers pass the **module-level** `getRecordDisplayName`:

- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx:105`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/SearchResultsPage.tsx:153`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/global-search-renderer.tsx:99`

A module-level function has a stable identity, so this repository is unaffected — which is exactly why no test here can go red and why this is worth a card rather than a comment. ⚠️ Commandment #10 says the same thing about itself: *«Nothing enforces this rule»*, and an ordinary pin that does not **force** the identity to change passes identically on defect and fix.

## ⛔ What this card does not claim

⛔ Not that any consumer is hitting it today — no such consumer was measured, inside this repo or outside it. The claim is that a **published option** is wired in a way its own repository forbids, and that the failure lands on whoever passes the obvious spelling.

⛔ It also does not prescribe the fix. Commandment #10 names the direction (re-key on the primitives or payload objects actually read, or move the cache out of React), but whether `getDisplayName` belongs in that array at all — it is read inside the run, not used to decide whether to run — is a reading of that effect, not a guess.

## 查重词

`useRecordSearch getDisplayName effect dependency` · `published hook function identity useEffect dep` · `debounce never fires inline resolver` · `objectui#8640` · `AGENTS.md #10`
